body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M_{2,\mathrm{loc}}\), the process \(h_i\) is a centered \((2r+1)\)-block factor and \(\Omega_{\mathrm{pop}}\ge0\). The equality \(\Omega_{\mathrm{pop}}=0\) holds if and only if a square-integrable \(2r\)-block factor \(g_i\) satisfies \(h_i=g_i-g_{i-1}\) almost surely; in that case \(N_n^{-1}\sum_{i\in I_n}h_i=(g_{n-r}-g_r)/N_n\), and \(\sum_{i\in I_n}h_i\Rightarrow g^\star-g_0\).
body.justification: This cited corollary interprets the diagnostic null as the known finite-block coboundary boundary rather than as causal homogeneity.
body.gap: Janson2015, Theorems 1--2 and Corollary 1 already establish the finite-dependent coboundary and endpoint laws; this proposition only specializes that published substrate to the declared score notation.
body.consumer: A researcher who fails to reject can report the correct boundary interpretation without claiming that unit-level exposure effects are constant.
